usage: Camera decisions are designed, not defaulted. Depth is a number per layer; parallax falls out of projection, not hand-tuned drifts.

projection.model: 2.5D planar dolly: k = focal / (focal - z - dolly); layer translate origin by -cam.x*p, screen scale by k/k_ref

parameters.overscan: plates rendered ≥15% larger than frame; crop budget documented

moves.when: busy content, data reading, most lower thirds
arrival of a claim, entering a diagram
moves.rules: one push per shot; settle before text resolves; secondary planes at depth ratios
drift direction must match reading order (RTL right-to-left reading flow for Arabic)
focus keyframes per AGENTS rack; blur distance proportional to |z - focus|
temporal samples ≥4 at shutter 180°, pre-position incoming content
only when content outside the old frame matters next

anti_default: No arbitrary zoom on every shot. If removing the camera move changes nothing, remove it.
verification: no layer crosses camera plane (k>0 guard)
determinism: identical frames at identical t in different call order
